## Описание задачи

Создай V3 artifact package, который содержит ровно один новый project file:

`.ai/subprojects/ork_planner/ork_planner_plan_full.md`

Это должен быть первый сильный черновик большого planner document, который:

- объясняет, как внедряется вся система `Planner -> Orc` через pilot subproject `ork_planner`;
- удерживает Planner в границах роли;
- задаёт safe route до первого реального Orc run и дальше до local proof;
- описывает, как потом поднимаются минимально нужные repo-level выравнивания;
- не создаёт и не нормализует Orc-owned docs как будто они уже живые.

### Expected document shape

Внешний draft обязан идти по strict outline. Допустимы малые улучшения формулировок, но не смена skeleton.

Обязательные смысловые разделы:

1. Title and document purpose
2. Quick navigation
3. Mission of `ork_planner`
4. Non-goals and forbidden drifts
5. Source basis and source authority order
6. Planner role boundaries
7. Planner-owned vs Orc-owned artifacts
8. Canonical artifact model for this pilot
9. Lifecycle overview from planning to first Orc run
10. V3 / V1 / Kilo usage and `recommend or waive` rule
11. First V3-first-draft route and why it is not `/v3` import-entry
12. First Orc nav pass
13. Battle-plan creation and approval gate
14. Three hard phases of the pilot
15. Local proof and human acceptance model
16. Repo-level alignment wave after local proof
17. Session binding and `session != journal`
18. Minimal required blocks for future `plan_navigation`, `plan_index`, `readme`, `navigation`, `status`, `journal`, `decisions`, `plan_active_N`
19. Compact migration map
20. `Unresolved Decisions`
21. `Acceptance Gates`
22. `Anchor Map`

### Depth requirement

Этот документ должен быть большим и подробным.

- Не возвращай краткий outline.
- Не сжимай объяснения до нескольких абзацев.
- Пиши как operational master document, пригодный как strong first draft для реального planner artifact.
- Если есть выбор между краткостью и полнотой, выбери полноту.

## Acceptance Criteria

```text
- Package is a real ZIP artifact package, not just prose advice.
- manifest.yaml is present and consistent.
- README_FOR_KILO.md is present.
- README_FOR_CODEX.md is present.
- checksums.sha256 is present.
- files/ contains exactly one project file.
- The only project file is .ai/subprojects/ork_planner/ork_planner_plan_full.md.
- The document clearly treats Planner and Orc as distinct roles.
- The document does not create or normalize Orc-owned files as already-live artifacts.
- The document explicitly describes first V3-first-draft route, first Orc nav pass, battle-plan gate, and three hard phases.
- The document includes explicit sections Unresolved Decisions, Acceptance Gates, and Anchor Map.
- The document treats historical scaffold only as reference-only.
- The document keeps Planner -> Orc as the only active route.
- The document does not revive Boss/B1/Junior Orchestrator as active terminology.
- The document is substantial and detailed, not a short summary.
```

## Known Risks

```text
- You may drift into drafting multiple files instead of one plan_full file.
- You may collapse Planner and Orc into one blended role.
- You may silently copy the old historical scaffold shape.
- You may under-specify the Orc bootstrap and battle-plan gates.
- You may forget session binding and session/journal separation.
- You may return a polished summary instead of a large operational document.
- You may create Orc-owned docs prematurely.
```
